Ever since I was a child, I have always been passionate about computers and technology. Technology has the power to change the world.

During my final-year project, I built a recommendation engine that served 3,000 test users. This taught me how data shapes everyday decisions.

I am a hard-working and dedicated student. Mistakes were made in my early projects, but I learned from them and became better.

I want to join this program because it is one of the best in the world and it will help me achieve my dreams of working in artificial intelligence.
